role: Director of Comprehensive Planning, State of New Hampshire
stance_basis: letter explicitly states concurrence with the Draft Environmental Statement as written with no additional comments
summary: Alexander M. Taft, Director of Comprehensive Planning for the State of New Hampshire, submitted a brief letter concurring with the Draft Environmental Statement as written and offering no additional comments of his own. He also forwarded responses from other New Hampshire state agencies, some of which raised substantive concerns about noise standards, permit issuance for ORV events, and the need to evaluate specific plans for federal lands within the state.
complaint_summary: Taft concurs with the Draft Environmental Statement as written, has no additional comments of his own, and transmits enclosed responses from other New Hampshire state agencies.

statement.text:
The Draft Environmental Statement relative to the proposed implementation of Executive Order 11644 pertaining to the use of off-road vehicles on public lands has been reviewed by this office, and we concur with the Statement as written and have no additional comments.
As the designated State Clearinghouse under the provisions of Circular A-95, we distributed the Statement to other interested state agencies for their review. Enclosed are copies of the responses and comments we have received.
Sincerely,
Alexander M. Taft
